title: Polyreel
tagline: A front end app, to interact with the Len's Protocol API and other apps built with the Len's Protocol
description: This project is a front end to interact with the Len's Protocol API.  User can sign in, create and manage profiles, make posts, comment on other posts, mirror posts, follow and unfollow and other basic social network UI.  Users can easily change profiles and interact with posts from other apps built with the Len's Protocol
how_its_made: Built with the Len's Protocol API.  Deployed on IPFS with Fleek.co.  Most of my difficulty was around using the graphql for the first time and cleaning user inputs for making a mutation.   I really wanted to use Livepeer to set up live streaming and post recorded videos, but ran out of time.
